SYMPTOM: FillTemplate exercise options tap repeatedly misses — coordinate-based taps (50%,47%) hit labels or gaps
CAUSE: Options are shuffled each run (SeededRNG or random), so Y% positions change between test runs
FIX: Use Maestro `tapOn: text: "partial option text"` instead of coordinate taps for FillTemplate options
PREVENT: Any time answer options can be shuffled, use text-based tapping not coordinate-based

Additional issue: SpotTheFlaw 'Check Flaws' button requires at least 1 word selected — tapping at 50%,65% hit below the word area. Fix: tap actual word coordinates (30-55% Y range) before tapping Check Flaws.
